# Development installers

V2 Development source is prepared. Its installer, `wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev1_amd64.deb`, has **not been built yet**. Building is paused until the requested reboot.

The existing `wallaby-agent_1.0.0~dev2_amd64.deb` is the previous V1 installer and still includes Jellyfin SSH Administration. It does not contain the V2 changes. The earlier V1 dev1 package is superseded because of its IPv6 local-forwarding bug.

See the repository README for the two remaining V2 services and the V1 upgrade procedure. Checksums currently refer to V1 artifacts only.
